content:
Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of sales orders.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to sales orders.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for sales orders.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of sales orders. You can include order conditions, fulfillment details, or any other relevant information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing sales orders using this footer will not be affected.
